events.board:
HARVEST FAIR TODAY!
Bring your best fruit and
show it to your neighbors.
The biggest apple wins
bragging rights for a year.
talk: It's the Harvest Fair! I've been polishing my pears since sunrise.
Harvest Fair day! Did you bring any fruit? Mine is the shiniest, I checked.
The fair smells like apples and wood smoke. Best day of the season!

events.board:
APPLE DAY
Share an apple with a friend
today. Any apple will do,
but a red one says it best.
talk: Happy Apple Day! Have you shared an apple with anyone yet?
An apple a day, they say. Today it's an apple for everyone!
